opening.argument: The Daily Show interview is framed around exposing cryptocurrency conduct, and its description identifies the conversation as a discussion of crypto’s ugly truths. The speakers examine alleged past misconduct: a code change said to have allowed borrowing of customers’ assets, and interviews with people described as Celsius scam victims. They also criticize paid advertising that persuaded people to convert real dollars into something else. Those details are presented as reporting and documentary discussion, not as an invitation for viewers to participate financially. The documentary mention and subscription prompt concern media content and ordinary channel engagement; neither is presented as a payment or credential request.
